speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, could you describe the nature and severity of your flank pain, and has it been accompanied by any changes in your urinary habits, such as frequency, urgency, or burning sensation?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood or cloudiness in your urine? Also, have you experienced any nausea or vomiting alongside the fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: The rash following amoxicillin and subsequent symptoms strongly suggest acute interstitial nephritis. I need to verify renal function and look for signs of an allergic reaction in the urine. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Creatinine, CBC
